20-minutes-till-dawn-v1.0.0.description: _A roguelike survival shooter where you fight off Lovecraftian hordes until dawn by flanne_ **Randomizer Features** - Ability to select individual Characters / Weapons to include / exclude from generation - Ability to customize how many Characters (1-13) and Weapons (2-11) to play with - Ability to set / randomize the starting Map - Ability to customize starting Darkness (0-15) and the Darkness level considered fully survivable in logic - Optional Weapon Attribute Randomization with a configurable per-attribute chance - 4 unique traps to experience with configurable weights - Death Link support (with the ability to toggle it off with a command) - Scales well for all types of multiworlds: Short / Long Syncs, Asyncs; ~160-1100 checks - Custom client UI that displays important information and updates in real-time - No manual mod installation required! The Archipelago client hooks into the game at runtime. Nothing else to download, install, or configure. - Feature-complete and tested **Locations** - Per Map: - Kill Count Checkpoints - Per Character / Weapon: - Survival Time Checkpoints - Player Level Checkpoints **Items** - Forbidden Tomes - Progressive Darkness Reductions - Per Map: - Map Unlock - Progressive Timers (+4 Minutes per) - Per Character: - Character Unlock - Progressive Powerup Choices - Heart Containers - Soul Heart Capacity - Per Weapon: - Weapon Unlock - Per Rune: - Rune Points **Setup Guide:** [Here](https://github.com/SerpentAI/Archipelago/blob/20_minutes_till_dawn/worlds/twenty_minutes_till_dawn/docs/setup_en.md)
